download_url: download a file from a URL to a local directory with optional MD5 checksum verification
download_and_extract_archive: download and extract a tar or zip archive from a URL to a specified directory
calculate_md5: calculate the MD5 checksum of a file at the given path for integrity verification
extract_archive: extract a tar, tar.gz, gzip, or zip archive file to a target directory
read_image_file: read a Pascal Vincent format image tensor file and return it as a PyTorch tensor
